state_code: Source jurisdiction abbreviation joined through the configured name/code schema crosswalk; eight main states/territories only.
family: Accepted APC taxonomic family, not ALA raw-name family.
genus: Accepted APC genus within its family.
year: Source occurrence calendar year; compare complete years separately from partial_year.
jurisdictions: Published region jurisdictions, or listing indicative jurisdictions depending on table.
protected_jurisdictions: Jurisdictions contributing terrestrial protected area in the published bioregion summary.
contribution_to_nrs_percent: Published bioregion contribution to total National Reserve System protected area; not its own protected share.
ibra_version: Version of the IBRA geographical classification used by the CAPAD summary.
protection_snapshot: Reference date of the CAPAD protection data, not download date.
scientific_name: Accepted APC canonical taxon name; phrase names remain identifiable.
apc_taxon_id: Exact accepted taxon identifier used to join the preserved source tables.
national_status_match: Unambiguous current extant national threat match, or null when no verified match was assigned.
selection_reason: Source-derived ranking rule choosing this focal example; not a biological explanation.
all_retained_records: Complete eligible occurrence count for a focal taxon before stricter point-display filtering.
point_eligible_records: Complete focal-taxon record count meeting known uncertainty and sensitivity/generalisation rules.
displayed_points: Actual number of published focal point markers.
sampled: Whether displayed_points is smaller than point_eligible_records.
sampling_method: Deterministic record selection rule; hashes choose records without changing their coordinates.
maximum_uncertainty_m: Configured upper coordinate-uncertainty limit for the point display.
uid: ALA dataResource identifier; join with focal_points.provider_id.
records_used: Actual retained occurrence count credited to the provider.
rights: Original export provider rights text; record-specific conditions still apply.
doi: Original provider dataset DOI where supplied; no new DOI is fabricated.
boundary_code: Official ABS 2026 state identifier, used for provenance.
checklist_species: Distinct accepted APC species entries satisfying the configured taxonomy and native-origin policy.
recorded_species: Distinct eligible APC species with at least one retained occurrence; presence documentation, not complete species richness.
records: Unique retained ALA record IDs; not individual plants or population abundance.
species_count: Distinct eligible species in the file-specific category; refer to each table scope.
verified_threatened_species: Distinct species with an unambiguous exact-ID match to one of the three extant national threat categories. State table counts only species with retained records in that state; family table counts the entire selected checklist.
verified_threatened_share_percent: 100 × state verified_threatened_species / state recorded_species; not a risk estimate for the complete flora.
unresolved_status_species: Recorded species affected by conflicting matched listing categories; other unmatched species are not included in this narrow field.
status: Current national listing snapshot category, not historical status on the occurrence date.
share_percent: 100 × category species_count / all matched extant threatened species.
partial_year: True for request year: incomplete calendar year, shown separately in C5.
protected_percent: Published CAPAD terrestrial protected-area share, retained without recalculation from display geometry.
area_ha: Published terrestrial jurisdiction/bioregion area in hectares.
protected_area_ha: Published terrestrial protected area in hectares.
longitude: WGS84 degrees; official ABS reference point in state_summary, original ALA coordinate in focal_points.
latitude: WGS84 degrees; official ABS reference point in state_summary, original ALA coordinate in focal_points.
uncertainty_m: Provider coordinate uncertainty in metres; focal points require a known nonnegative value within configured limit.
species_key: Stable SHA-256-derived display key; resolve scientific name and APC ID through focal_species.
record_id: Original ALA record ID; unique after deduplication.
provider_id: Original ALA dataResource UID; join to occurrence_source_credits.uid.
licence: Original record licence label, not a licence invented for the derived page.
focus_category: Boolean waffle tile fill; tile allocation rounds the exact CR share.
bin_end: Exclusive upper boundary except final bin, which includes 100%.
region_count: Number of CAPAD IBRA 7.1 bioregions in the numeric interval; not species or records.
